name: DBLog Time Filter
description: Adds quick time range filtering options to the Recent Log Messages page (/admin/reports/dblog).
project_description: DBLog Time Filter enhances Drupal Core's "Recent Log Messages" report page (/admin/reports/dblog, backed by the core 'watchdog' View) with two debugging aids implemented entirely through Views alter hooks. It adds a "Time" select to the View's exposed filter form offering relative ranges (last 10 minutes, hour, 12 hours, day, week) that filter watchdog rows by timestamp, and it displays a live "Current Server Time" clock above the form that ticks every second using a client-side offset from the server timestamp captured at page load. The module ships no config, routes, permissions, services, or plugins; it is a small .module file plus one JS/CSS library. Its own project page notes it is intended as a temporary convenience that may be sunset if equivalent features land in Drupal Core.
